Pakistan-EU Hold Counterterrorism Dialogue 

🔗⬇️

text: Pakistan and the EU held the annual CT Dialogue in Islamabad today. Both sides reviewed ongoing bilateral and multilateral cooperation in counter-terrorism. Reaffirming their commitment, both sides agreed to carry forward their shared resolve to combat terrorism in all its forms.
